description: This file defines the Equality class used for representing and comparing pairs of objects, likely within the context of refinement types in PyTorch's FX experimental module.

classes.name: Equality
classes.description: A class representing a pair of objects with methods for string representation and equality comparison.

methods.name: __init__(self, lhs: object, rhs: object)
methods.description: Initializes an Equality instance with a left-hand side (lhs) and right-hand side (rhs) objects.

methods.name: str __str__(self)
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Equality instance in the format 'lhs = rhs'.

methods.name: str __repr__(self)
methods.description: Returns a representation string similar to __str__, primarily for debugging.

methods.name: bool __eq__(self, other: object)
methods.description: Defines equality comparison between this Equality instance and another object, returning True if both are Equality instances with identical lhs and rhs.
